items.title: Reddit aims to make ‘karma’ less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation tools
items.summary: Reddit is expanding its moderation tools and building stronger abuse prevention systems that it says could eventually reduce communities’ reliance on karma and account-age requirements, making it easier for legitimate newcomers to participate.

items.title: Lucid Motors just delayed its affordable EV. Now what?
items.summary: The Cosmos EV is now slated for release in the second half of 2027. CEO Silvio Napoli said he's focused on getting the EV right, as well as its nearer-term robotaxi project with Uber and Nuro.

items.title: Meet the eight startups pitching at Startup Battlefield Australia
items.summary: The applications are in, and the TechCrunch Startup Battlefield team made their decisions!

items.title: PSA: Apple’s Private Relay can leak your real IP address
items.summary: A bug in how Apple implements its Private Relay feature, which in theory masks users’ IP addresses from the sites they visit, can reveal users’ real IP addresses.

items.title: Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google
items.summary: Shopify says AI isn’t cannibalizing search traffic the way it has for publishers. Instead, AI-driven traffic and orders to Shopify stores tripled year over year in Q2.

items.title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
items.summary: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.

items.title: Zoox to start charging for robotaxi rides in Las Vegas
items.summary: This marks the official launch of Zoox's commercial operations.

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s Real World AI Stage features robots, automated factories, and extinct animals
items.summary: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

items.title: As Gen Z reconsiders dating apps, Tinder’s IRL events expand to dozens more cities
items.summary: Tinder is expanding its in-person events feature from an initial Los Angeles test to 26 cities worldwide by the end of September.

items.title: Trump EPA wrongly canceled $20B in climate funds, appeals court rules
items.summary: Climate nonprofits can again access their federal funding more than a year after the Trump EPA ordered Citibank to freeze their accounts.

items.title: Anthropic is hiring an AI chip design team
items.summary: Anthropic is building a team for designing its own custom AI chips. The Claude maker said it would co-design hardware and models to help its technology run faster and more efficiently.

items.title: Disney+ looks to TikTok creators to bring fan content to its short-form video feed
items.summary: As streamers compete with social media giants for viewer attention, Disney+ is partnering with TikTok to bring creator content to its app.

items.title: MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
items.summary: MacPaw is building a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models.

items.title: Robinhood to list a fund that lets anyone back Y Combinator startups
items.summary: Robinhood's latest financial instrument intends to let any retail investor feel like they, too, can make money by backing Y Combinator startups.

items.title: Indian EV startup River raises $120M Series C to scale production, launch more models
items.summary: River plans to build a new factory, launch additional models from 2027, and target profitability as it scales production.

items.title: Saudi Aramco backs India’s Mitti Labs to make Asia’s rice farming more water-resilient
items.summary: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.

items.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
items.summary: WindBorne Systems has raised a $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

items.title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
items.summary: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

items.title: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call
items.summary: Musk kept inflating the already-big promises being made by SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and Gwynne Shotwell on the company's first call.

items.title: Lucid’s turnaround plan hinges on $1.4B in cash savings, robotaxis
items.summary: Lucid's new CEO Silvio Napoli listed four must-win priorities, including the successful launch of its midsize EV, finishing a factory in Saudi Arabia, cutting expenses, and robotaxis.
